name: x
description: Read-only access to X (Twitter) through the official v2 API. Search posts, look up users, read timelines, and browse your own bookmarks, home feed, and likes.

X_BEARER_TOKEN.title: X Bearer Token
X_BEARER_TOKEN.description: App-only bearer token from the X Developer Portal. Required for read-only v2 calls. Create one at https://developer.x.com/en/portal/dashboard.

X_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: X OAuth Client ID
X_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. OAuth 2.0 Client ID from the X Developer Portal (app type Web App, redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8917/callback). Enables the start_login tool for bookmarks and personal feeds.

X_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.title: X OAuth Client Secret
X_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with the client ID above.
